question: हमें रात (Night) को कहानी (Story) कौन सुनाता है? 📖👴👵
explanation: Yay! Our दादा-दादी (Grandparents) tell us the best bedtime stories! 📖
hint: They are your parents' parents.

question: पिताजी (Father) के पिताजी को क्या कहते हैं? 👴
explanation: Awesome! Father's father is called दादा (Dada/Grandpa)! 🌟
hint: He is the oldest man in the house.

question: पिताजी (Father) की माताजी को क्या कहते हैं? 👵
explanation: Super star! Father's mother is your sweet दादी (Dadi/Grandma)! ✨
hint: She tells you beautiful stories.

question: दादाजी (Grandpa) सुबह (Morning) कहाँ जाते हैं? 🌳🚶
explanation: Great! दादाजी (Grandpa) goes to the पार्क (Park) for a fresh walk! 🚶
hint: It is a place with lots of green trees.

question: दादी (Grandma) हमें क्या करना सिखाती हैं? 🤗❤️
explanation: Fantastic! दादी (Grandma) teaches us to share प्यार (Love) with everyone! ❤️
hint: It is a beautiful and happy feeling.

question: दादाजी (Grandpa) आँखों पर क्या लगाते हैं? 👓
explanation: Brilliant! दादाजी (Grandpa) wears चश्मा (Glasses) to read! 👓
hint: It helps them see clearly.

question: दादाजी (Grandpa) चलने के लिए क्या पकड़ते हैं? 🦯
explanation: Good job! He uses a छड़ी (Stick) to walk safely! 🦯
hint: It is long and made of wood.

question: हम दादा-दादी (Grandparents) के साथ क्या करते हैं? 🧩😊
explanation: Yay! We love to खेल (Play) fun games with them! 🎲
hint: It makes everyone happy and smile.

question: दादी (Grandma) हमारे लिए क्या बनाती हैं? 🍲😋
explanation: Yummy! दादी (Grandma) cooks delicious खाना (Food) for us! 🥘
hint: You eat it when you are hungry.

question: हमें दादा-दादी (Grandparents) को देखकर क्या करना चाहिए? 🙏
explanation: Super! We should always say नमस्ते (Namaste) to show respect! 🙏
hint: We fold our hands to do this.

question: दादा-दादी (Grandparents) हमें क्या देते हैं? 🎁❤️
explanation: Wonderful! They give us their sweet आशीर्वाद (Blessings)! ✨
hint: It is a wish for your good luck.

question: दादी (Grandma) के बाल (Hair) कैसे होते हैं? 👩‍🦳
explanation: Perfect! When we grow old, our बाल (Hair) become सफ़ेद (White)! 🤍
hint: It is the color of milk and clouds.

question: दादा-दादी (Grandparents) के साथ घर (Home) कैसा लगता है? 🏡😊
explanation: Awesome! A घर (Home) with them is full of खुशी (Happy) moments! 🥰
hint: You smile a lot when you feel this.

question: हमें दादा-दादी (Grandparents) की बात कैसे सुननी चाहिए? 👂
explanation: Good job! We must listen ध्यान से (Carefully) because they are wise! 🌟
hint: You use your ears and focus.

question: दादाजी (Grandpa) हमें बाज़ार (Market) से क्या दिलाते हैं? 🎈🍬
explanation: Yay! Grandpas love buying us fun खिलौने (Toys) from the shop! 🚗
hint: You play with them.

question: जब दादाजी (Grandpa) थक जाते हैं, तो हम क्या करते हैं? 💆‍♂️
explanation: So sweet! We दबाना (Massage) their legs to help them relax! 🥰
hint: You use your hands gently on their legs.

question: दादी (Grandma) हमें क्या सिखाती हैं? 🎶🗣️
explanation: Beautiful! We learn lovely गीत (Songs) and prayers from grandma! 🎤
hint: You sing this with a melody.

question: दादा-दादी (Grandparents) का कमरा (Room) कैसा रखना चाहिए? 🧹✨
explanation: Excellent! Keeping their room साफ़ (Clean) shows we care! 🧹
hint: No dust and nicely organized.

question: दादी (Grandma) हमें किसमें सुलाती हैं? 🛌💤
explanation: So nice! Sleeping in grandma's गोद (Lap) feels so safe and warm! 😴
hint: You sit on it when they sit on a chair.

question: हम दादा-दादी (Grandparents) का क्या करते हैं? 🙏❤️
explanation: Super star! We must always give सम्मान (Respect) to our elders! 🌟
hint: Treating someone very nicely and politely.

question: दादाजी (Grandpa) पोधे (Plants) को क्या देते हैं? 🌱💦
explanation: Great! Plants need पानी (Water) to grow big and strong! 🌱
hint: It comes from the tap and rain.

question: दादी (Grandma) पूजा (Prayer) कहाँ करती हैं? 🛕🙏
explanation: Awesome! We go to the मंदिर (Temple) to pray and find peace! 🙏
hint: A holy place with a bell.

question: दादा-दादी (Grandparents) के साथ हमारी क्या होती है? 😂💬
explanation: Yay! Sharing बातें (Talks) with them makes us smile! 😄
hint: You use words and your voice.

question: दादी (Grandma) स्वेटर (Sweater) कैसे बनाती हैं? 🧶
explanation: Brilliant! Warm sweaters are knitted ऊन से (With Wool)! 🧣
hint: It comes from sheep.

question: हम दादाजी (Grandpa) के साथ कहाँ सैर (Walk) करने जाते हैं? 🚶‍♂️🌳
explanation: Fantastic! A बगीचा (Garden) has beautiful flowers and trees! 🌷
hint: A place with green grass and butterflies.

question: दादाजी (Grandpa) अखबार (Newspaper) कब पढ़ते हैं? 📰☀️
explanation: Perfect! Reading the news in the सुबह (Morning) is a great habit! ☕
hint: When the sun rises.

question: दादी (Grandma) हमें क्या कहकर बुलाती हैं? 👦👧❤️
explanation: So sweet! Grandparents lovingly call us बेटा (Child)! 🥰
hint: A loving word for a boy or girl.

question: जब हमें चोट (Hurt) लगती है, तो दादा-दादी (Grandparents) क्या करते हैं? 🩹🥺
explanation: Yay! They सहलाना (Comfort) us and make the pain go away! ❤️
hint: They hug you and say it will be okay.

question: दादा-दादी (Grandparents) हमारे परिवार (Family) के क्या हैं? 🌳🏠
explanation: Super! They are the strong जड़ें (Roots) that hold the family together! 💪
hint: The bottom part of a tree in the soil.

question: दादी (Grandma) हमें मेले (Fair) में क्या खिलाती हैं? 🎡🍬
explanation: Yummy! Everyone loves eating मिठाई (Sweets) at the fair! 🍩
hint: They are very sugary and tasty.

question: दादा-दादी (Grandparents) का हाथ (Hand) पकड़कर चलना कैसा लगता है? 🤝🚶
explanation: Awesome! Holding their hands makes us feel सुरक्षित (Safe) and loved! 🤝
hint: You feel protected, like nothing bad will happen.

question: दादा-दादी (Grandparents) कौन सी कहानियाँ (Stories) सुनाते हैं? 🧚‍♀️🐉
explanation: Magical! We love hearing परियों की (Fairies) stories before sleeping! ✨
hint: Stories about magical people with wings.

question: त्यौहार (Festival) पर दादा-दादी (Grandparents) क्या बांटते हैं? 🎉
explanation: Yay! Festivals with them are full of खुशियाँ (Happiness)! 🎊
hint: A joyful and smiling feeling.

question: हमें दादा-दादी (Grandparents) की मदद (Help) कब करनी चाहिए? 🤝
explanation: Super star! We should हमेशा (Always) be ready to help them! 🌟
hint: Every single day.

question: दादाजी (Grandpa) रेडियो (Radio) पर क्या सुनते हैं? 📻🎶
explanation: Great! Old गाने (Songs) on the radio are so peaceful to listen to! 📻
hint: Musical sounds with words.

question: दादी (Grandma) हमें किस चीज़ से बचाती हैं? 🛡️❤️
explanation: Haha! Grandmas always protect us from mom and dad's डांट (Scolding)! 🤫
hint: When parents are angry at you.

question: दादा-दादी (Grandparents) को देखकर हमारे चेहरे (Face) पर क्या आती है? 😄
explanation: Beautiful! They always bring a big मुस्कान (Smile) to our faces! 😄
hint: Showing you are happy with your lips.

question: हम दादाजी (Grandpa) के कंधे (Shoulders) पर बैठकर क्या देखते हैं? 👦👀
explanation: Yay! Sitting tall on Grandpa's shoulders to see the मेला (Fair) is so much fun! 🎡
hint: A place with big rides and games.

question: दादा-दादी (Grandparents) हमारे घर (House) की क्या हैं? 🏡✨
explanation: Awesome! They bring brightness and रौनक (Charm) to our beautiful home! 🌟
hint: Something that makes a place shine and feel alive.

question: दादी (Grandma) रात को हमें क्या उढ़ाती हैं? 🛌❄️
explanation: So warm! Grandma covers us with a कंबल (Blanket) so we don't feel cold! 🛌
hint: A thick, warm cloth for sleeping.

question: दादाजी (Grandpa) हमें किस बात की शिक्षा (Teachings) देते हैं? 📚🧠
explanation: Brilliant! Grandpa always teaches us सच्चाई and अच्छाई (Goodness)! 🌟
hint: Doing the right things and being nice.

question: हम दादा-दादी (Grandparents) को प्यार से क्या कहते हैं? 💕
explanation: Yay! We lovingly call them our sweet दादा-दादी (Grandparents)! ❤️
hint: They are your parents' parents.

question: दादी (Grandma) अपने बक्से (Box) में क्या रखती हैं? 🧰
explanation: So sweet! Grandmas keep lovely old photos and यादें (Memories) safe! 📸
hint: Old pictures and special old things.

question: दादाजी (Grandpa) हमें साइकिल (Bicycle) चलाना कहाँ सिखाते हैं? 🚲
explanation: Fantastic! A मैदान (Playground) is the best safe place to learn cycling! 🚴
hint: A big open space outside.

question: हम दादा-दादी (Grandparents) के साथ समय (Time) बिताकर कैसा महसूस करते हैं? ⏳🥰
explanation: Yay! Spending time with family always feels बहुत अच्छा (Very Good)! 😊
hint: A happy and positive feeling.

question: दादी (Grandma) हमें कौन सा फल (Fruit) छीलकर देती हैं? 🍎🔪
explanation: Yummy! Grandmas lovingly cut sweet सेब (Apples) for us to eat! 🍏
hint: A red, sweet, crunchy fruit.

question: दादाजी (Grandpa) हमें क्या करना सिखाते हैं? 🚶‍♂️
explanation: Super! From childhood, they hold our hands and teach us कदम बढ़ाना (Walking)! 🚶
hint: Moving forward on your two feet.

question: परिवार (Family) में सबसे बड़े (Eldest) कौन होते हैं? 🌳👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
explanation: Great! Our दादा-दादी (Grandparents) are the eldest and wisest in the house! 🌟
hint: They have white hair and lots of experience.

question: दादी (Grandma) के माथे (Forehead) पर क्या चमकती है? ✨
explanation: Beautiful! Grandma wears a lovely red बिंदी (Bindi) on her forehead! 🔴
hint: A small round dot worn on the head.

question: दादा-दादी (Grandparents) का प्यार (Love) कैसा होता है? ❤️♾️
explanation: Yay! Their pure love for us is always सच्चा (True) and endless! ❤️
hint: It is real and very big.
